boundary.evidence: self-contained CLI gate in comprehensive-test-strategy/scripts; wired into SKILL Step 5

ownership.evidence: thresholds/classification config-driven; reads report+config, writes nothing

dependency.evidence: grep-battery clean — node:fs/node:path only, no web/transport

error-handling.evidence: die→exit 2 on usage/unparseable/zero-tests/layerless; exit 1 threshold breach; parseFloat||0 deliberate
asserts exit codes + fail-closed; mutation-verified discriminating

findings.title: requirePyramid hardcoded unit/integration/e2e → silent PASS for other layer names (false pass)
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a repo with layers unit/component/ui + requirePyramid gets 0>=0>=0=true → an inverted cone passes green; the gate's headline feature is vacuous for them
findings.evidence: reviewer PROBE D: 1 unit/1 component/8 ui + requirePyramid → exit 0 (should be 1)
findings.resolution: order now derived from Object.keys(cfg.layers) (declared base→top), counts must be non-increasing; test with custom names added

findings.title: maxUnclassifiedShare optional → mostly-untagged suite passes on a tiny classified sample (false pass)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: 9/10 untagged + 1 unit → shares computed on 1 test (unit=100%) → passes; the fail-closed guard the ADR relies on evaporates when the key is omitted
findings.evidence: reviewer PROBE E: 1 /unit/ + 9 /misc/, no maxUnclassifiedShare → exit 0
findings.resolution: defaults maxUnclassifiedShare to 0.2 whenever any shape threshold is set (documented); test with default guard added

findings.title: unescaped '>' in a classname attribute truncates the <testcase> tag → test dropped to unclassified
findings.question: under-engineering
findings.whatBreaks: a '>' (XML-legal in attr values) truncates the tag; classname unreadable → misfiled unclassified, moving the pass/fail boundary
findings.resolution: quote-aware regex allows '>' inside quoted attribute values; test added

verdict: 3 findings (2 med false-pass, 1 low), all fixed with tests
